anime.description: Fourth season of PetitCure: Precure Fairies.

title.native: お姉ちゃんごっこ

anime.description:
In the distant future, on the outskirts left behind by the rapid concentration of advanced science and technology in urban areas, lies a remote mountain village known as Kagami Village.
“Behave yourself, or a Double will come for you.”
Such old folklore still lingers in this village.

Akane Higure, a middle school student living in Kagami Village, has been eagerly awaiting the return of her older sister, Sui Higure, who is finally being discharged from the hospital after a year.
However, not long after her sister comes home, Akane receives a single phone call.

“The girl at home with you… isn’t your sister.”

title.native: FX戦士くるみちゃん

anime.description:
University student Kurumi Fukuga has finally fulfilled her long-held desire of starting foreign exchange (FX) trading, motivated by recouping the 20 million yen her late mother lost in trading. "I'll easily make it back," she thought, but the world she enters can become heaven or hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations… but she still wants to buy, sell and make money! With fellow FX addicts Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko along for the ride, the market heats up! Joy, despair, joy, despair — this is an endearing, yet slightly risky money game. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.romaji: Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen desu!
title.native: ガールズ＆パンツァー もっとらぶらぶ作戦です！

anime.description:
A deep dive into the untold daily lives and the inter-school interactions of the Ooarai Girls' team and the other students (along with the colorful characters that surround them) who are wholeheartedly dedicated to the way of the tank!

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: The series had a four-part theatrical pre-screening in Japan starting in December 2025. Regular TV broadcast began in October 2026.

• Part 1 releasing theatrically on December 26, 2025.
• Part 2 releasing theatrically on January 30, 2026.
• Part 3 releasing theatrically on March 6, 2026.
• Part 4 releasing theatrically on April 10, 2026.
synonyms: Girls & Panzer - Motto Love Love Sakusen desu!

title.native: 氷の城壁 第2期

anime.description:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by…

(Source: Netflix)

title.native: てつりょー！meet with 鉄道むすめ

anime.description:
Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about.

At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement!

As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder.

(Source: Pony Canyon Anime)

anime.description: The second season of Kizu darake Seijo yori Houfuku wo Komete.

title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Chishiki de Musou Suru
title.english: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
title.native: 追放された転生重騎士はゲーム知識で無双する

anime.description:
Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn’s future shatters when he awakens the so-called “defective” Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the “weakest” class.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Kesatria Kelas Berat Tereinkarnasi yang Diasingkan Jadi Tanpa Tanding Dengan Pengetahuan Gimnya

title.romaji: Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II
title.english: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
title.native: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べるⅡ

anime.description:
Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
synonyms: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2

title.native: マゼンチュ

anime.description:
Mazenchu is set in a school where all kinds of food can live out their youth and form friendships, rivalries, and bittersweet romances.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 时光代理人 第三季

anime.description:
After the Li Tianchen case comes to a close, peace appears to return to Time Photo Studio—until the disappearance of Xia Fei draws everyone back into a web of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's newfound abilities, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang begin uncovering the truth behind the mysterious Bahati fire.

As the investigation deepens, hidden connections emerge between the case and Cheng Xiaoshi's parents. Meanwhile, Liu Xiao, a member of a mysterious organization, sets his own plans in motion, while the intervention of Inspector Jae introduces new uncertainties. As secrets buried in the past resurface, the search for truth becomes more dangerous than ever.

(Source: bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run - 2nd & 3rd STAGE
title.english: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd STAGE
title.native: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スティール・ボール・ラン 2nd＆3rd STAGE

anime.description:
In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide..

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)
synonyms: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Part 7–Steel Ball Run

title.native: パンどろぼう

anime.description:
Kadokawa announced on June 9th, 2025 that Keiko Shibata's Pan Dorobou (Bread Thief) picture book will have an anime adaptation. The announcement did not reveal the anime's format. The picture books center on a piece of bread that also steals bread from bakeries in the city.

(Source: Anime News Network)

anime.description: A new dream and adventure set throughout the entire Pokémon world unfolds in a brand new Pokémon-series following a girl named Liko and a boy named Roy.

title.native: Duel Masters LOST ～断罪の少年～

anime.description: Sequel to Duel Masters LOST: Boukyaku no Taiyou.

title.native: 蒼き伝承 ウェルシュ&シェーダー

anime.description:
The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: とある暗部の少女共棲

anime.description:
This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City.

In Academy City where "ESP" has been recognized as a general science. Behind the peace, there is a Dark Side organization that undertakes missions that cannot be made public.

"ITEM" is an elite unit consisting of four girls. Takitsubo Rikou is able to read and track the AIM fields emitted by those with abilities. Frenda Seivelun, who excels in combat using explosives and traps.

Kinuhata Saiai, who can manipulate nitrogen at will and plays a defensive role. And one of the 7 Espers that Academy City is proud of: Mugino Shizuri. They live freely in the darkness of the Academy City, and quietly set their sights on their target...!

This is a story of encounter, friendship, and darkness that eventually leads to a terrible incident!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 薬屋のひとりごと 第3期

anime.description:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."

To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.

From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: ホタルの嫁入り

anime.description:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.english: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
title.native: 桃源暗鬼 日光・華厳の滝編

anime.description:
After battling in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade for their "the total eradication of the Momotaro."

When Shiki realizes that they also target noncombatants, he sets out after Yaoroshi to bring him back. Meanwhile in Nikko, there's a research facility for horrific experiments atop the old Kegon Falls…

(Source: REMOW)

title.native: うちの弟どもがすみません

anime.description:
The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.english: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc
title.native: 東京リベンジャーズ 三天戦争編

anime.description: Sequel to Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku-hen.

パンの赤ちゃん

anime.description:
Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time.

It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless!

(Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)

title.native: 择日飞升

anime.description:
In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...

(Source: iQ)

title.english: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan
title.native: 斗罗大陆2绝世唐门

anime.description:
The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?
</br></br>
(Source: WeTV)
synonyms: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect

title.native: 大王饶命 第三季

anime.description: The third season of Dawang Raoming.

title.native: しろたん
クレヨンしんちゃん

anime.description:
Crayon Shin-chan follows the wacky antics and adventures of five-year-old Shinnosuke "Shin" Nohara and his parents, neighbors, and friends and is set in Kasukabe, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.

Many of the jokes in the series stem from Shin-chan's occasionally weird, unnatural and inappropriate use of language, as well as from his inappropriate behavior. A typical gag involves Shin-chan confounding his parents by using the wrong phrase for the occasion; for example, saying "Welcome back!" instead of "I am back!" when he comes home.

During the beginning of the series, the TV show was mostly based on the storyline in the original manga. As the show progressed, more and more episodes became anime-original.

title.native: ドラえもん (2005)

anime.description: A new Doraemon series produced by the same team as the 1979 series (in association with Studio Pierrot) with new voice actors and staff and updated character designs.

title.native: 朱色の仮面

anime.description:
"The Mask” gives power to anyone who wears it.

At times, that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy…

Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends, and even his own master.

In order to prevent this type of tragedy from reoccurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston’s masks that are spread around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronting powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master.

(Source: The Vermillion Mask English Site)

title.native: 名探偵コナン

anime.description:
Kudo Shinichi is a seventeen year-old high school detective whom people call the "Modern Sherlock Holmes." However, one night after a date with his childhood sweetheart, Ran, Shinichi witnessed an illegal trade and, caught off his guard, was knocked unconscious and fed a drug that was supposed to kill him... but he woke up and found himself shrunken to a seven year-old. In order to track down the men who did this to him, Shinichi hid his identity and lived with Ran, whose father happened to be a hopeless detective, and with that came a series of murders and mysteries that he must solve.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.english: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
title.native: マロニエ王国の七人の騎士

anime.description:
At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)
synonyms: Os Sete Cavaleiros do Reino Marronnier

title.romaji: Romelia Senki: Maou wo Taoshita nochi mo Jinrui Yabasou dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita
title.native: ロメリア戦記 〜魔王を倒した後も人類やばそうだから軍隊組織した〜

anime.description:
Romelia and her party succeed in defeating the Demon King Zelgis, though Prince Henri’s reckless charge forces them into a grueling battle. In the aftermath, Romelia is branded "dead weight" for not fighting directly, and the Prince unilaterally breaks off their engagement. Denied a place in the victory celebrations, Romelia returns home, only to be met with cold indifference from her family and society. Yet, she refuses to break. She has already set her sights on the path that lies ahead.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Romelia War Chronicle was streamed 2 days in advance of the TV broadcast on AnimeTimes, U-NEXT, and Netflix beginning October 3, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 5, 2026.

title.romaji: Tensei shita Dai Seijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hita Kakusu
title.english: A Tale of the Secret Saint
title.native: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す

anime.description:
Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she’s the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: The series streamed a week in advance on ABEMA, Prime Video, and Crunchyroll starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.

title.romaji: Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! 2nd Season
title.english: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2
title.native: 野生のラスボスが現れた！ 第2期

anime.description: The second season of Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta!

title.native: ブラッククローバー 第2期

anime.description:
As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: #ゾンビさがしてます

anime.description:
It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it’s amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they’ve never felt more alive.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: バーテックスフォース

anime.description:
Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family however harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira on the other hand has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events start happening around the world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 恐怖コレクター

anime.description:
Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own. But with his help, you may just live to see another day…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.romaji: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
title.native: マジカル★エクスプローラー　エロゲの友人キャラに転生したけど、ゲーム知識使って自由に生きる

anime.description:
Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and d anime store. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2026.
synonyms: Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim

title.romaji: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
title.english: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
title.native: 生徒会にも穴はある！

anime.description:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards. However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

(Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)
synonyms: สภานักเรียนฉบับรั่ว!

anime.description: The third season of Ranma 1/2 (2024).

title.romaji: Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu
title.english: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
title.native: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収

anime.description:
If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out?

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収～用済みとパーティー追放された俺は、可愛いサポート妖精と一緒に取り立てた魔力を運用して最強を目指す。～
Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu ~Youzumi to Party Tsuihou sareta Ore wa, Kawaii Support Yousei to Issho ni Toritateta Maryoku wo Unyou shite Saikyou wo Mezasu.

anime.description: Second season of Odekake Kozame.
synonyms: A Little Shark Going Out. Season 2

title.native: ゆるゆる図鑑

anime.description:
Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime!

Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!"

Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

title.native: タヌキとキツネ

anime.description:
The story centers on the daily lives of a raccoon dog who is not quite with it and a mischievous fox who likes to tease the raccoon dog. The two are close friends who live together on a mountain. Their other friends include a wolf, a bear, a rabbit, and birds.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: サザエさん

anime.description: The main character is a mother named Sazae-san. She lives in a house with her husband, her kid, her siblings and her parents. The show is the ultimate family program and tends to follow traditional themes. Think of this show as the Japanese equivalent to "The Partridge Family" and you'll get a good feel for this show's atmosphere. Don't expect to see things like violence, swearing, kung-fu action or magical girls. The plots are more like "Today, Sazae-san goes to the new mall and gets lost". Such "boring" plotlines and the simplistic art are often a turn-off to non-Japanese audiences, but most Japanese find the show incredibly good. As a result, it continues to be one of the top ratings grabbers on TV and is one of the few anime that is considered "acceptable" by adults.

Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.

In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.”

When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality. It was supposed to be a safe training exercise designed to improve their magical abilities. But instead, it marks the beginning of a carefully orchestrated nightmare - a forbidden trial. A new Magical Girl Raising Project has begun.

By chance, he awakened the soul of an ancient war god, thus defying fate. He swept through sect geniuses, overcame powerful enemies and obstacles, encountered a soulmate, used his battle spirit to break all laws, and forged a legend with his blood. From a humble young master, he rose through the ranks to become an invincible supreme celestial being who shakes the nine realms.

(Source: IQIYI, translated)

title.native: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン

A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer.

Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat!

Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: 幻想水滸伝

anime.description:
Two young boys... the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom - a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region.

The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return.

Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war.

The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

(Source: Official Website, translated)

title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka Suru.: Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?

title.native: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。　～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～

anime.description:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.

Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.

The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.

Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.

This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!

(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow —

the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall…

A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments.

title.native: ONE PIECE

anime.description:
Gold Roger was known as the Pirate King, the strongest and most infamous being to have sailed the Grand Line. The capture and death of Roger by the World Government brought a change throughout the world. His last words before his death revealed the location of the greatest treasure in the world, One Piece. It was this revelation that brought about the Grand Age of Pirates, men who dreamed of finding One Piece (which promises an unlimited amount of riches and fame), and quite possibly the most coveted of titles for the person who found it, the title of the Pirate King.

Enter Monkey D. Luffy, a 17-year-old boy that defies your standard definition of a pirate. Rather than the popular persona of a wicked, hardened, toothless pirate who ransacks villages for fun, Luffy’s reason for being a pirate is one of pure wonder; the thought of an exciting adventure and meeting new and intriguing people, along with finding One Piece, are his reasons of becoming a pirate. Following in the footsteps of his childhood hero, Luffy and his crew travel across the Grand Line, experiencing crazy adventures, unveiling dark mysteries and battling strong enemies, all in order to reach One Piece.

*This includes the following special episodes:
- Chopperman to the Rescue! Protect the TV Station by the Shore! (Episode 336)
- The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle! (Episode 492)
- Team Formation! Save Chopper (Episode 542)
- History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea (Episode 590)
- 20th Anniversary! Special Romance Dawn (Episode 907)
